mapper.select: SELECT main_order_flow_no FROM ftp_tc_user_common_warning WHERE id_ = #{id}

SELECT w.id_, w.svc_num, w.cust_name, w.developer_name, w.developer_id, w.prod_name, w.hq_svc_type, w.user_status, w.area_name, w.county_id, w.open_date, w.warning_info, w.ep_special_scheme_name, w.ep_special_create_date, w.ep_special_eff_date, w.ep_special_exp_date, w.grp_code, w.grp_name, w.main_order_flow_no, w.county_id AS county_name, c.cycle_flag, c.warning_info AS cycle_warning_info FROM ftp_tc_user_common_warning w LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning c ON c.order_flow_no = w.order_flow_no AND c.id_ = (SELECT MAX(c2.id_) FROM ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning c2 WHERE c2.order_flow_no = w.order_flow_no) WHERE w.warning_type = '000032' AND w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} ORDER BY w.id_
